messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Media in German Democratic Republic (1949-1990) during the 1980s, matching this research need: survey data on TV viewing behavior and audience evaluations of specific television programs and series in the DDR, including reception frequency, perceived realism, moderator and character ratings, entertainment value, demographics, and reception conditions
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: DDR Fernsehen Zuschauerforschung 1980er Umfrage Sendungen Serien Realitätsnähe Moderatoren ZIJ Datensatz
GESIS DDR Fernsehrezeption 1980er Zuschauer Bewertungen Sendungen Datensatz
DDR television audience research survey 1980s dataset viewing programs ratings
action.query: DDR Fernsehen Zuschauerforschung 1980er Umfrage Sendungen Serien Realitätsnähe Moderatoren ZIJ Datensatz

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 23. Woche 1987 (SFR 23/87)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10522","justification":"Highly relevant survey dataset collected on June 9, 1987, by the State Committee for Television of the GDR. Contains television viewing participation and program evaluations, including perceived realism and informational value of the film DER FREISCHÜTZ IN BERLIN, ratings of main characters, evaluations of the moderator and entertainment segments of WENNSCHON – DENNSCHON, and audience reception of WETTLAUF MIT DER ZEIT. Particularly suitable for studying perceived realism, character ratings, moderator evaluations, and program-specific audience responses."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 50. Woche 1982 (SFR 50/82)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7047","justification":"GDR television audience survey conducted on December 16, 1982. Includes viewing participation, evaluations of television programs, entertainment value (humor, wit, and amusement), reasons for watching KLOCK 8, ACHTERN STROM, satisfaction with program quality, and desired improvements. Also records the number of episodes watched and audience evaluations of the series BUSCH SINGT. Especially relevant for analyzing reception frequency, entertainment value, satisfaction, and evaluations of television series."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 36. Woche 1985 (SFR 36/85)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7189","justification":"Audience survey from 1985 covering television viewing and evaluations of individual programs. Includes ratings of SPORT AKTUELL moderators, perceived realism and entertainment value of POLIZEIRUF 110 – EIN SCHRITT ZU WEIT, audience expectations, and assessments of DIE DRITTE FRAU, including sympathy toward fictional characters. Particularly useful for examining moderator ratings, character evaluations, realism, suspense, and entertainment preferences."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 35. Woche 1988 (SFR 35/88)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.10584","justification":"Highly relevant 1988 audience survey covering program reception and evaluation. Includes perceived realism and entertainment value of POLIZEIRUF 110: EIFERSUCHT, ratings of main characters, evaluations of moderators and humor in GLÜCK MUSS MAN HABEN, and viewing frequency of DAS VERKEHRSMAGAZIN. Also examines perceived usefulness of program content, technical presentation, and entertainment value. Provides a strong match for studying reception frequency, realism, character ratings, and audience satisfaction."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 6. Woche 1983 (SFR 6/83)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7055","justification":"GDR television audience survey from 1983 measuring viewing participation and program evaluations. Includes entertainment value and moderator ratings for BONG, perceived target age groups, regular viewing of PORTRÄT PER TELEFON: HEINZ QUERMANN, and evaluations of MAGDEBURGER MOTIVE. Also investigates regular audiences, humor, entertainment value, and suggested improvements for KLOCK 8, ACHTERN STROM. Useful for analyzing program loyalty, moderator evaluations, viewing frequency, and entertainment preferences."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 13. Woche 1985 (SFR 13/85)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.7166","justification":"Television audience research from 1985 investigating viewing participation and evaluations of specific programs. Includes suspense and perceived realism of POLIZEIRUF 110 – TRAUM DES VERGESSENS, fulfillment of audience expectations, viewing frequency of KULTURMAGAZIN, and preferences regarding cultural programming. Also examines occupational characteristics, physical and mental workload, fatigue after work, and expectations of television programming. Particularly relevant for connecting program evaluations with reception conditions and respondents' everyday circumstances."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 14. Woche 1982 (SFR 14/82)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7012?lang=en","justification":"1982 survey examining television viewing behavior and audience assessments of specific GDR programs. Measures entertainment value and realism of DER STAATSANWALT HAT DAS WORT: HOFFNUNG FÜR ANNA, perceived crime-prevention effects, the number of episodes watched of DU UND DEIN HAUSTIER, and realism and entertainment value of DER NOTNAGEL. Also includes awareness of several other television programs. Suitable for studying program familiarity, series viewing frequency, perceived realism, and audience evaluations."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 5. Woche 1985 (SFR 5/85)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7158?lang=en","justification":"1985 GDR audience survey examining viewing behavior, program evaluations, and the social circumstances of television reception. Includes reasons for watching AUF SCHUSTERS RAPPEN, moderator ratings, conversations with family members while watching television, entertainment value of the film AUßENSEITER, and suggestions for improving the program STOP!. Especially valuable for research on reception conditions, family viewing environments, moderator evaluations, and entertainment preferences."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 46. Woche 1984 (SFR 46/84)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7147?lang=de","justification":"Representative household survey from 1984 examining GDR television reception and program evaluations. Includes audience assessments of UMSCHAU, interest in specific program topics, familiarity with television schedules, preferred broadcasting times for youth programming, the influence of shift work on television viewing, and parental influence on children's viewing behavior. Uses a stratified random household sample drawn from television subscriber records. Particularly useful for studying demographic differences, household viewing behavior, and reception conditions."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 39. Woche 1982 (SFR 39/82)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7464?lang=en","justification":"Representative GDR television audience survey from 1982 measuring viewing participation and evaluations of specific broadcasts. Includes detailed audience assessments of KOMM MIT MIR NACH CHICAGO, covering entertainment, relaxation, sympathy toward characters, representation of young people's experiences, and overall impressions. Also evaluates the program KNOBELEIEN, including its presentation, moderators Regina Liebsch and Ullrich Klein, and studio game segments. Particularly suitable for character ratings, moderator evaluations, perceived authenticity, and entertainment value."},{"title":"Sofortresonanzen DDR Fernsehen 28. Woche 1989 (SFR 28/89)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA7389","justification":"1989 GDR television audience survey examining program reception and audience satisfaction. Includes evaluations of the presenter and participating artists in SHOWKOLADE, reception of PFUNDGRUBE, ratings of its female moderator, appreciation of musical variety, and overall satisfaction with GDR television programming. Useful for studying presenter evaluations, entertainment preferences, program-specific audience responses, and broader satisfaction with the television system."},{"title":"Medienstudie zur Fernsehsendung Hautnah 1987","url_or_doi":"https://access.gesis.org/dbk/16402","justification":"Media reception study conducted in 1987 by the Zentralinstitut für Jugendforschung in Leipzig. Focuses on the GDR youth television program HAUTNAH, including assessments of its moderators' interviewing and discussion techniques, program content, and audience interest in comparable youth television formats. Also examines educational and occupational decision-making issues addressed by the program. Particularly relevant for studying moderator evaluations and the reception of youth-oriented television programming in the late GDR."}]}
